messages:
Alex R: Quick check — Northbridge private deploy targeted for Tue 2024-04-12. Can owners confirm network/firewall + airgap artifact readiness? We hit a signing failure in staging earlier and want to lock down fallbacks.
Priya K: Customer confirms 4/12 is the go date. We need a final test window on 4/10.
Mateo L: Working on egress NAT + routing tasks. Need static IPs from NetOps to finalize route table. @Nora any chance you can share the CIDR ranges we should publish?
Nora: Posted ranges in the runbook but happy to paste here. The customer wants /24s not single IPs. Snippet:```
# firewall rules example
allow tcp 443 from 203.0.113.0/24 -> customer-proxy
allow tcp 443 from 198.51.100.0/24 -> s3-gateway
```
Mateo L: Perfect, that format works. I’ll update the terraform and push a plan by EOD tomorrow.
Sam O: FYI artifact signing issue summary: our staging pipeline used the staging key, the airgap bundle in staging failed HSM verify on target side. PR to pick correct key name is up: https://git.redwood/infra/airgap/merge_requests/412
deploy-bot: Canary created: northbridge-canary-2024-04-10T02:00Z (owner: Mateo L)
Alex R: Ownership check: Mateo = routing + canary, Nora = IPs/certs + NetOps contact, Sam O = artifact signing + airgap upload, Priya = customer comms. If anyone can’t take these, say now.
Mateo L: I can own routing + canary smoke tests. NAT IP list ETA EOD tomorrow.
Nora: Cert rotation scheduled for 2024-04-09. Need vendor to confirm HSM key access window — @Priya K can you confirm contact availability?
Priya K: Vendor confirmed via DM, HSM window ok. Also customer requires egress locked to specific S3 buckets — please add bucket ARNs to runbook and IAM policy.
Sam O: PR #412 is ready for review (small variable name fix). After merge I’ll cut the signed artifact and push to the airgap registry. ETA 2024-04-09 morning.
Alex R: Risk callout: if signing slips we fallback to a temporary pull-proxy hosted in the customer VPC to serve artifacts. Sam, can you doc commands for that fallback?
Sam O: Will add a short fallback doc in the runbook today. Quick example command I’ll include:```
# fetch and serve artifact locally
curl -sSf https://internal-registry.example/artifacts/northbridge.tar.gz | tar xz -C /var/airgap && ./airgap-server --artifact /var/airgap/northbridge.tar.gz --listen 0.0.0.0:8080
```
Mateo L: Smoke plan for canary: hit /health -> expect 200, then run 5 qps for 60s and verify p95 < 300ms. I’ll add the script to the runbook and attach results to the canary ticket.
Priya K: :thumbsup: thanks all. I’ll update the customer timeline and send a confirmation after Sam posts the fallback doc.
Alex R: Great. Action items recap in-thread: Mateo -> terraform + smoke script; Nora -> confirm CIDRs + cert rotation; Sam -> merge PR #412 + upload signed bundle + fallback doc; Priya -> vendor contact + customer comms. If anything slips, escalate here first.
Mateo L: Acknowledged.
Nora: Acknowledged.
Sam O: Ack, will ping when upload done.
Priya K: Ack.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: runbook-check 2024-04-08T16:00Z
